agyos_skill.intent: Use when conducting freelancer discovery calls, defining value-based pricing models, drafting Statements of Work (SOW) or proposals, negotiating project budgets/scopes, or managing client kickoff/payment conversions.
agyos_skill.instructions: Convert interested prospects into paying clients with professional discovery calls, value-based pricing, bulletproof proposals, and seamless closing rituals. To utilize this skill's core scripts, proposal templates, or negotiation responses, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [03A-DISCOVERY-CALL.md](references/03A-DISCOVERY-CALL.md) | Discovery Call System | Calendly configuration, pre-call qualification, 7-question discovery call script, call notes template | | [03B-PRICING-STRATEGY.md](references/03B-PRICING-STRATEGY.md) | Pricing Strategy | Value-based pricing psychology, Good-Better-Best tier design, rate escalation ladder | | [03C-PROPOSAL-TEMPLATES.md](references/03C-PROPOSAL-TEMPLATES.md) | Proposal & SOW Templates | Statements of Work, mutual agreements, payment schedules, one-page proposal template | | [03D-NEGOTIATION-PLAYBOOK.md](references/03D-NEGOTIATION-PLAYBOOK.md) | Negotiation Playbook | 8 objection handling scripts, scope defense, value-add upselling | | [03E-CLOSING-RITUALS.md](references/03E-CLOSING-RITUALS.md) | Closing Rituals | Confirmation triggers, deposit invoicing, kickoff sequences | When preparing for or documenting a discovery call: - Reference [03A-DISCOVERY-CALL.md](references/03A-DISCOVERY-CALL.md) to apply the **BANT Qualification** framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline). - Guide the conversation using the **7-Question Script** to uncover the client's current pain point, the cost of not fixing it, and the business metrics of success. - Record call outcomes using the call notes template. When helping a freelancer calculate project rates or write proposal options: - Reference [03B-PRICING-STRATEGY.md](references/03B-PRICING-STRATEGY.md) to anchor pricing against business value (targeting 10-20% of the value delivered, rather than hours worked). - Structure proposal pricing using a three-tier **Good-Better-Best framework** to increase contract values and let clients choose scope limits rather than negotiating on rates. When drafting a proposal or Statement of Work: - Reference [03C-PROPOSAL-TEMPLATES.md](references/03C-PROPOSAL-TEMPLATES.md) to build the SOW containing: detailed milestones, clear out-of-scope lists, client responsibilities, and a formal **Change Request Process**. - Recommend a **50/25/25 payment schedule** (50% upfront deposit, 25% at midway milestone, 25% on delivery) or upfront payment models. When asked to respond to client pushback, rate objections, or requests for free work: - Reference [03D-NEGOTIATION-PLAYBOOK.md](references/03D-NEGOTIATION-PLAYBOOK.md) to handle objections (e.g., "Your rate is too high," "Can we do a paid trial?", or "We need this faster"). - Defend project boundaries by trading budget reductions directly for scope reductions (never lower rates without reducing scope). When closing the sale and initiating the project: - Reference [03E-CLOSING-RITUALS.md](references/03E-CLOSING-RITUALS.md) to lock in commitments using the low-friction **"Reply YES to Confirm"** email template. - Trigger deposit invoices and schedule onboarding calls immediately.
